en_title: Producer of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Movie Reportedly Working on New Silent Hill Film
cn_title: 《生化危机》电影制片人据称参与《寂静岭》新片
subtitle: 又一恐怖游戏改编
opus_summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，曾参与制作Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》电影的Roy Lee，正在参与一部《寂静岭》电影。新片尚未获官方确认，具体情况也未公布。

paragraphs.en: A new report from The Wall Street Journal states that Roy Lee, who produced Zach Cregger’s hugely-successful Resident Evil movie, is now working on a Silent Hill film.
paragraphs.cn: 《华尔街日报》最新报道称，曾制作Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》电影的Roy Lee，如今正在参与一部《寂静岭》电影。此前那部《生化危机》电影取得了巨大成功。

paragraphs.en: Roy Lee is a Hollywood legend. The producer has had a hand in some of the most successful movies of the last three decades and has a speciality for adapting pre-existing IP, specifically where horror is concerned.
paragraphs.cn: Roy Lee是好莱坞的传奇制片人。过去30年里，他参与制作了多部极为成功的电影，尤其擅长改编现有IP中的恐怖题材。

paragraphs.en: He began his career with horror hits like The Grudge and The Ring, and went on to produce Zach Cregger’s Barbarian and Weapons 20 years later. Most recently, he helped bring Cregger’s Resident Evil to life, which has become the single most-successful film adaptation of Capcom’s video game series ever and the highest-rated video game movie of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 他早年凭《咒怨》和《午夜凶铃》等热门恐怖片起步，约20年后又制作了Zach Cregger的《野蛮人》和《凶器》。最近，他参与制作了Cregger执导的《生化危机》电影。该片成为卡普空这一游戏系列迄今最成功的电影改编作品，也是有史以来评分最高的游戏改编电影。

paragraphs.en: Now, it seems that he’s working on yet another iconic survival horror franchise: Silent Hill.
paragraphs.cn: 现在看来，他似乎又在参与另一个标志性的生存恐怖系列：《寂静岭》。

paragraphs.en: The Wall Street Journal published a feature about Roy Lee on September 20, where the outlet shed some light on the producer’s upcoming video game-related projects.
paragraphs.cn: 《华尔街日报》于9月20日刊发了一篇Roy Lee的专题报道，披露了他接下来参与的部分游戏相关项目。

paragraphs.en: According to the article, Lee has a staggering 20 or so movies and television adaptations for video games that are in development or production right now. These include Prime Video’s God of War series , Michael B. Jordan’s Battlefield movie , and, most curiously, “Japanese horror classic Silent Hill.”
paragraphs.cn: 报道指出，Lee目前参与的游戏改编影视项目多达约20个，均处于开发或制作阶段。其中包括Prime Video的《战神》剧集、迈克尔·B·乔丹参与的《战地》电影，以及最引人好奇的「日本经典恐怖游戏《寂静岭》」。

paragraphs.en: The existence of a new Silent Hill movie has not been publicly confirmed at the time of writing this article; however, Konami has been extremely bullish on the franchise as of late, releasing two Silent Hill games in as many years, both of which have been well-received.
paragraphs.cn: 截至本文撰写时，《寂静岭》新电影尚未得到公开确认。不过，科乐美近来十分看好这个系列，连续两年各推出了一款《寂静岭》游戏，两款作品都获得了不错的反响。

paragraphs.en: Silent Hill producer Motoi Okamoto also revealed that Konami hopes to release a new game in the series every year as it works to reinvigorate its IPs across the board, including titles like Castlevania. With this in mind, the fact that another Silent Hill movie is getting made so soon after the release of Return to Silent Hill isn’t too surprising… especially given the success of Cregger’s Resident Evil.
paragraphs.cn: 《寂静岭》制作人冈本基还透露，科乐美希望每年推出一款系列新作，同时推动旗下包括《恶魔城》在内的各个IP重焕活力。考虑到这一点，《重返寂静岭》上映后不久就有另一部《寂静岭》电影投入制作，倒也不太令人意外……尤其是在Cregger的《生化危机》取得成功之后。

paragraphs.en: Return to Silent Hill , however, was a flop. It’s safe to say that hardcore fans of the franchise hated it, and critics’ opinions weren’t much better. We at IGN scored the movie a five out of 10 , saying in our review that it “isn’t the worst entry in this video game movie series, but it fails to accomplish anything that the source material doesn’t do better.”
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《重返寂静岭》却遭遇了失败。可以说，系列铁杆粉丝讨厌这部电影，影评人的评价也好不到哪里去。IGN给该片打了5分（满分10分），并在影评中写道：「它不是这个游戏改编电影系列中最糟糕的一部，但它没能呈现出任何比原作更出色的东西。」

paragraphs.en: For now, fans can remain cautiously optimistic for a better take on Silent Hill now that Lee is reportedly bringing his expertise to the project... though Resident Evil fans have been somewhat divided as to how Cregger handled the source material in his latest movie, particularly its ending .
paragraphs.cn: 眼下，既然据称Lee将凭借自己的专长参与这个项目，粉丝可以谨慎期待它带来一部更好的《寂静岭》电影……不过，对于Cregger在最新电影中如何处理《生化危机》原作，尤其是结局，《生化危机》粉丝的看法有些分歧。
